  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 3:06 PM, Chair Supernaw called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Boardmembers Present: Supernaw, Duggan, Wood

Boardmembers Absent: Allen, Jones

Also present: Bob Dowell, General Manager, Director, Department of Energy Resources; Rich
Anthony, Principal Deputy City Attorney; Jane Hermsen, Board Secretary, Manager, Electric
Generation Bureau; Matt Eaton, LACSD; William Chen, LACSD; Dawn Kamei, Administrative Analyst;
Michele York, Secretary/Electric Generation Bureau.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-52229  Recommendation to approve the minutes of the Southeast Resource Recovery
  Facility Authority meeting of Wednesday, March 29, 2023.

  A motion was made by Chair Supernaw, seconded by Boardmember Wood, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Supernaw, Duggan, Wood
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Absent: 2  Allen, Jones

2.  24-52230  Recommendation to hold an election of Chair and Vice Chair of the Southeast
  Resource Recovery Facility Authority, Effective July 1, 2024.

  Page 1 of 3
   SOUTHEAST RESOURCE RECOVERY
  FACILITY (SERRF) MINUTES
  THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 15, 2024
  2400 EAST SPRING ST. BLDG. 570
  ENERGY RESOURCES, 2ND FL, CONFERENCE ROOM, 3:00 PM

  A motion was made by Boardmember Duggan, to nominate herself as
  Chair. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Supernaw, Duggan, Wood
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Absent: 2  Allen, Jones

  A motion was made by Boardmember Wood, to nominate himself as Vice
  Chair. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Supernaw, Duggan, Wood
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Absent: 2  Allen, Jones

  Chair Supernaw declared the nominations open for Chair and Vice Chair.

  Boardmember Duggan nominated herself for Chair of the Southeast Resource
  Recovery Facility Authority.

  Boardmember Wood nominated himself for Vice Chair of the Southeast Resource
  Recovery Facility Authority.

  There being no further nominations, Chair Supernaw declared the nominations
  closed for Chair and Vice Chair.

  A motion was made by Chair Supernaw, seconded by Boardmember Wood, to
  approve recommendation, as amended, to make the newly elected board
  effective by the end of the current meeting. The motion carried by the
  following vote:

  Yes:  3  Supernaw, Duggan, Wood
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Absent: 2  Allen, Jones

3.  24-52231  Recommendation to receive, adopt and file SERRF Manager's report for Fiscal
  Year 2023.

  A motion was made by Boardmember Wood, seconded by Chair Supernaw, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3 Supernaw, Duggan, Wood
